purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded access review; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The official Ayodhya district land-records page (the current district containing former Faizabad) links the Uttar Pradesh land-record portal. The Government of India DILRMP and UP Bhulekh district report identify Faizabad tehsil within Ayodhya and report cadastral-map digitization/georeferencing for local revenue villages. This is district/tehsil-level evidence; it does not confirm the WUP point’s specific urban village or public vector access. The official map app presents a login/captcha gate. Public district/tehsil dashboard establishes local map digitization but not the queue point’s specific village nor a public vector feature contract. No credentials or protected endpoints were attempted.

officialEvidence.observation: First-party district administration land-records page directs users to Uttar Pradesh land records; Ayodhya is the current district containing Faizabad tehsil.

Official Uttar Pradesh public dashboard report for Ayodhya district lists Faizabad tehsil and village-level revenue-map coverage/georeferencing counts. It does not establish the WUP point’s village or citywide vector availability.
Government of India DILRMP district/tehsil map-digitization report for Ayodhya (district code 177) includes Faizabad tehsil and local cadastral map status.
Official BhuNaksha page exposes a login form (user, password, captcha); no credentials, login, token, or protected query was used.
NIC BhuNaksha documentation describes the software as intended for authorized officials; used to bound access expectations.

viewer.observation: Official UP cadastral viewer entry presents an account/captcha gate. Public Ayodhya district progress is visible on UP Bhulekh; no anonymous full-geometry route or safe response schema was verified.

serviceTrace.notes: The WUP population centroid may fall in Faizabad urban revenue village, but point-to-village assignment was not resolved. Dashboard map counts are not evidence of complete city coverage or vector access.
